episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the transformative impact of AI on the real estate industry, emphasizing the importance of relationship building and personal branding for agents. The conversation also explores the challenges posed by industry giants like Zillow and Compass, and how independent brokerages can adapt and thrive.
